lastCompletedStory.title: Mirror the rubric guidance into the generic reviewer template and re-embed

nextStoryContext: Added a 'Test-quality rubric: expanding criterion #2' subsection to templates/agents/subagent-reviewer.md, inserted right after 'Green tests do not prove correctness' and before 'No-flaky-evasion hard stop' (same insertion point as US-002's .claude copy). Content was ADAPTED, not pasted verbatim: kept the anti-mock aphorism verbatim ('a test that asserts a mock was called is documentation, not verification') and the waitForCondition/adversarial-cases names per the acceptance criteria, but replaced cam-specific wire-boundary examples (git/tmux/gh) with generic ones (database/HTTP API/filesystem/queue), dropped the warren CONSTITUTION Art. IV citation and the CAM-55 fakes-lie backstory (not meaningful to a generic scaffolded project), and phrased the waitForCondition rule as 'a shared waitForCondition helper (or the project's equivalent)' since a downstream project won't have test/helpers/wait-for-condition.ts. Ran bun run embed-vendor to regenerate src/vendor/_generated.ts; embed-vendor:check, test/embedded.test.ts, typecheck, full bun test (4552 pass), and bun run check:all all green. No patterns.md bullet added: no new reusable insight beyond what 'cam dual-copy is per-file' already documents.
